title: Sturdy, but otherwise poor craftsmanship...and rust
text: Sturdy, but otherwise poor craftsmanship...and rust. You can see all the welds which makes it less attractive. It's not something I'd proudly give as a gift...not to mention that my base is rusty and has other weird imperfections on it. If I didn't need it tomorrow, I'd return it, but I'm stuck due to my own procrastination. That's not their fault of course. Maybe they would have replaced it. 2 stars for sturdiness.
